Value edge REAL but MODEST + real supply overhang -> smaller size and a LOWER limit than the staged STARTER.

court_record.dd: STARTER 7/10 — cheap + improving + honestly disclosed; only liquidity + a one-timer hold it below BUY. MODE B (led, disconfirming): (1) NPL trend is a CHANNEL-SHIFT but the aggregate is contained: nonaccrual FALLING $355M (Q2-23 peak)->$313M(24YE)->$241M(Q1-26) partly because bad credit is FORECLOSED into a fast-growing REO pile ($13M->$44M->$68M->$131.8M, 254 props, ~1.8% of the $6.5B book up from ~1.0%). CLEAN because REO is fair-value-less-costs marked QUARTERLY through P&L with rising honest write-downs (-$3.9M/-$6.1M/-$17.5M 2023-25) and the co earned 17.7% ROE AFTER the $17.5M markdown -> throughput/timing friction (slow judicial-state foreclosure), not a hidden solvency hole. (2) Improving ROE DURABLE/spread-driven (refutes the rate-artifact bear): NII $76M->$108M->$136M->$186M (2021-25) at stable 3.61% NIM off book $3.4B->$6.5B; assets reprice up vs fixed securitized debt -> spread WIDENS with rates. Caveat: FY25 $105M NI includes a $19.3M one-time Dec-2025 bulk-NPL-sale gain (~18%); strip -> ~$86M, P/E ~7.8x, ROE ~14% — still cheap/improving. (3) Funding = the real risk but de-risked 2026: non-recourse securitization $4.4B (VEL holds only residual) + termed-out corporate ($75M 9.875% due 2029 + NEW $500M syndicated 9.375% due 2031 Jan-2026) = $575M 5yr unsecured + non-recourse ABS; warehouse repos (full-recourse, capacity shrinks with DQ) the fragility but NOT forced sellers; ABS-market closure the tail. (4) Book REAL: FVO since Oct-2022 -> loans carry current MTM each qtr (no lagging ACL); $4.9M allowance tiny only because it covers the shrinking pre-FVO amortized-cost stub; marks cut both ways (Q1-26 +$26.3M unrealized gain as spreads tightened). (5) 'Make money on defaults' CORROBORATED: resolved NPLs recovered 102.3% UPB/106.4% incl accrued Q1-26; 102.7%/109.4% Q4-25; +$1.4M FY25 REO sale gains. Honest qualifier: recovery% measured on RESOLVED loans, not the $132M still in REO -> watch it holds as inventory clears. (6) Takeaway-vs-data divergence runs IN THE BUYER's FAVOR: thin near-lows tape implies a deteriorating lender; data shows ROE ~doubled (10%->17%+), NII up 2.4x, book $433M->$693M; the SCREEN itself understated it with a stale 12.9% multi-year-avg ROE. MODE A: CIK 1692376 + contract 399498047 confirmed; common equity = total equity $693.3M (Q1-26), NO preferred (Series A 45k redeemed Q4-2021), diluted 39.17M vs basic 38.63M (~1.5%); BVPS $17.66 vs $17.15 -> P/B 0.97; trailing P/E 6.2-6.4x ($108.5M TTM/$105.1M FY25 NI); identity implied P/E 0.97/0.173=5.6x vs reported 6.2x -> market prices VEL as if ROE reverts to ~10-11% (would need ROE ~9% to justify ~1x book at a 9-10x lender multiple) = the mispricing.
court_record.adjudication: STARTER — a genuinely cheap (~0.97x book, ~6x earnings), improving (17%+ ROE run-rate, spread-driven and rate-resilient), honestly-disclosed non-QM lender the market left on the table because it's thin and near its lows. The one substantive Mode-B catch (NPLs falling partly via foreclosure into a growing REO pile) is DISCLOSED, fair-value-MARKED quarterly, and expensed through a 17.7% ROE — a timing friction, not a masked loss — and the resolution economics (102-106% UPB recovery) that the thesis rests on hold up in the filings. The takeaway-vs-data gap runs in the buyer's favor. It is STARTER rather than BUY strictly on (a) thin $1.6M-ADV liquidity capping size + adding exit friction and (b) the ~18% one-time-gain flatter in the FY25 ROE headline. Fresh, diversifying (credit/duration axis, not P&C-cat), and the single conviction long the screen produced. STAGE-only; the principal places the GTC $16.50.
court_record.independent_court: DEPLOY-SMALLER (independent court, fresh agent, 2026-07-25; consistency: the financials-screen agent both FOUND and courted VEL — generator-adjacent — so this is a dedicated re-adjudication from primary SEC filings, not an inherit). CORE VALUE THESIS SURVIVES primary verification: (a) BVPS $17.67 / P/B 0.970 EXACT off audited Q1-26 equity $693,348k and 39,235,281 sh, NO preferred (Series A 45k redeemed) — VERIFIED; (b) NIM EXPANDED 3.34%->3.56%->3.61% (2023-25) WHILE cost of funds ROSE 5.58%->6.24% — the rate-resilient spread engine is REAL, refutes the margin-compression bear, VERIFIED from 10-K MD&A; (c) NPL recovery 102-109% of UPB across EVERY disclosed cohort 2023-2026 (long-term NPL FY23 102.4%/FY24 102.5%/FY25 102.9%; Q4-25 102.7%; Q1-26 102.3%) — holds THROUGH post-HPA cooling, refutes the 'HPA-artifact' bear, VERIFIED; (d) REO valuation adjustment Q1-26 ~-$3.2M (cash-flow stmt) annualizes ~-$12.8M, BELOW the -$8M/qtr kill line — did NOT accelerate after the Q4-25 bulk activity; (e) funding de-risked — new $500M 2026 Term Notes (VCC, Jan-30-2026), 'in compliance with ALL covenants' 3/31/26, no going concern — VERIFIED. Q1-26 CLEAN print (NI $22.363M, EPS $0.57, no one-timer) annualizes ~13.1% ROE / ~$2.28 EPS / ~7.5x P/E = the honest organic run-rate. HOWEVER the independent pass found THREE genuine risks the generator-adjacent screen SOFT-PEDALED: (1) THE ONE-TIMER IS A RELATED-PARTY TRANSACTION — the $19,344k FY25 gain (18.4% of $105M NI, 100% new to 2025) is 'Gain on Sale of Loans to a Related Party': VEL sold $128.9M UPB of nonperforming loans to an AFFILIATE in Dec-2025 (three sponsors own 84% of the co). Earnings-management-adjacent channel; MITIGANT — priced at ~102% recovery, in-line with historical organic NPL resolutions, so not an obviously-inflated markup, but it means underwrite the ~13-14% NORMALIZED ROE not the 17.5% headline. (2) FLOAT IS 84% PE-CONTROLLED (Snow Phipps/TruArc 34.0% / PIMCO 32.2% / Beach Point 17.7%) WITH AN ACTIVE MONTHLY FORM-144 AFFILIATE SELL-DOWN (12+ Form 144s Jul-2025->Jul-2026) — the '$1.6M thin ADV' is a controlled float being sold into, a persistent supply overhang that CAPS re-rating and adds exit friction, not benign neglect. (3) INSIDER OPEN-MARKET ACTIVITY IS NET SELLING (~$136k sampled sells across CFO/CLO/EVP/CAO in the $18-20 zone; ZERO open-market buys) — no management conviction at the lows. Also: the honest GROSS problem-loan number is $554.5M UPB / 8.5% of book (10-K), larger than the $241M-nonaccrual the screen led with (though marked + recovering). NET: the value edge is real but MODEST and the overhang is real -> DEPLOY-SMALLER than the staged STARTER, at a LOWER limit to demand more margin of safety. Live $17.15 (close-only, is_close=true), -17.4% YTD, 52wk $16.21-21.04. STAGE-ONLY confirmed (no VEL position, no VEL order in the IBKR book).

The value edge (0.97x book / ~7.5x normalized earnings, NIM-expanding, 102-109% NPL recovery) survives primary verification but is MODEST — hence DEPLOY-SMALLER, not the full staged STARTER.

edge_explainer.market_believes: A thin, near-52wk-low non-QM lender down 17% YTD — a deteriorating late-cycle real-estate credit book, priced at ~1x book / ~6x earnings because ROE is about to mean-revert toward ~10%.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The DIRECTION in the data is the opposite of the tape: ROE roughly doubled off the 2020-21 trough, NII compounded 2.4x at a RISING ~3.6% NIM (NIM widened 3.34->3.61% even as cost of funds rose 5.58->6.24% — the spread engine is rate-resilient, verified), book grew $433M->$693M, and resolved NPLs recover 102-109% of UPB across every 2023-26 cohort (verified, holds post-HPA). BUT the independent court corrected the headline: ~18% of FY25 NI ($19.3M) is a RELATED-PARTY NPL sale, so the honest run-rate is the Q1-26 CLEAN ~13% ROE, not 17.5%. You're paid to hold a low-teens-ROE spread lender at a trough-ROE (~0.92x book at the $16.25 limit) valuation — but in SMALL size, because the float is 84% sponsor-controlled and being distributed monthly (a supply overhang that caps the re-rating).
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: The market read the thin near-lows tape as deterioration; the primary filings show improvement, honest marks, and gain-on-resolution. The screen ITSELF understated it (stale 12.9% avg vs 17%+ run-rate). The residual edge is the value gap between a ~14-17% normalized ROE and a ~1x-book price that implies ~10%.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: It's a thin microcap in a late real-estate-credit cycle; the market may be correctly demanding a discount for the securitization-funding tail and the aging REO inventory. If foreclosure recoveries roll over as the $132M REO clears, ~1x book is fair, not cheap.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: REO clearing at >100% recovery + NII continuing to compound at ~3.6% NIM (confirming the spread engine) re-rates it toward book-plus; the ABS market staying open keeps origination growing. A recovery-rate break below 100% or accelerating REO write-downs breaks it.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: If resolution recoveries on the aged REO inventory come in below 100% of UPB (vs the 102-106% on recently-resolved loans), the 'makes money on defaults' cushion is weaker than the recent data implies and the channel-shift IS a slow-motion loss — that would flip STARTER to WATCH.
edge_explainer.edge_type: VALUE (real, modest) — a cheap, improving, honestly-disclosed spread lender at trough-ROE valuation; own in SMALL size on the limit ($16.50), thin-name discipline, not a table-pound only because liquidity caps it.
